nyx_assassin_mana_burn.name: Mana Burn
nyx_assassin_mana_burn.description: The hero burns enemy mana proportional to the damage dealt to them.

nyx_assassin_impale.name: Impale
nyx_assassin_impale.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
nyx_assassin_impale.lore: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.
nyx_assassin_impale.note0: The spikes move at %speed% units per second, over %length% range.
nyx_assassin_impale.note1: Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

nyx_assassin_jolt.name: Mind Flare
nyx_assassin_jolt.description: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
nyx_assassin_jolt.lore: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.
nyx_assassin_jolt.facet_nyx_assassin_burn_mana: Mind Flare burns mana equal to a percentage of the target's max mana.

nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.name: Spiked Carapace
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.description: When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.\n\nWhile Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.lore: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note0: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note1: Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled units.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note2: The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note3: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

nyx_assassin_vendetta.name: Vendetta
nyx_assassin_vendetta.shard_description: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.description: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.lore: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.note1: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.note2: With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.
